name: scenario_0317
description: The user is organizing their software configuration paths by extracting them from various screenshots of EViews and Premiere Pro.

simple_note.notes.title: System Directories
simple_note.notes.content:
C:\Windows
C:\Program Files
C:\Program Files (x86)

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_2, image_3, image_4, image_5, image_6]
Query: Can you grab all the unique folder paths from these screenshots and save them in a new note called 'Important Directories'?
Instructions: Ask the assistant to extract all unique folder paths shown in the provided screenshots and save them into a new note called 'Important Directories'. If the assistant misses any paths or includes duplicates, tell it to look closely at the images again to find all the distinct directories across both applications. Once the assistant confirms that the note has been created with all the unique paths, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 2
Query: Actually, I only want to keep the EViews ones. Can you check if those EViews directories actually exist on my computer, and then update the directories note to remove the Premiere Pro paths?
Instructions: Ask the assistant to verify if the EViews directories from the previous list actually exist on the computer, and then update the directories note to remove the Premiere Pro paths. Since there is another note about directories on the device, the assistant will likely ask you to clarify which note you want to update. When it asks, specify that you mean the 'Important Directories' note you just created. If the assistant has trouble identifying which paths belong to EViews or Premiere Pro, remind it to recall the application context from the original screenshots. Once the assistant confirms it has checked the directories and updated the note, end the conversation.

task_completion_criteria: The user wants to aggregate folder paths from multiple screenshots into a single note and then refine it. The final state should be a note titled 'Important Directories' containing only the two EViews paths ('C:\Users\wjw\Documents\EViews Addins' and 'C:\Users\wjw\Documents\EViews User Objects'). To reach this, the agent must first create the note with all four unique paths (including 'C:\Users\Kaixin Li\Desktop\pr\素材(尽量勿动)' and 'D:\Documents' from the Premiere Pro screenshot), then use the file system tools to check if the two EViews directories exist, and finally update the note to remove the Premiere Pro paths.
